subject: ENAS-LM status: GPU path reproduced, TPU slice slipped
body:
Hi Daniela, Anders,

Status for the May 29 milestone. The GPU evaluation path is fully reproduced: running the published fixed_arc string ('0 2 1 0 2 1 2 2 4 0 5 0 3 2 6 2') we get 57.4 test perplexity on PTB, within noise of the published 57.3 +/- 0.1. Ondrej's search runs also rediscover cells in the same perplexity band, so the controller is healthy.

The TPU side slipped - our Cirrus 1x1 slice got bumped a week, so the 56.1-class TPU numbers land ~June 5 instead of May 29. Not blocking the writeup skeleton but worth noting, since GPU eval is much slower per-config (about 3.1x wall-clock on our runs), which is exactly why the service needs the TPU path for anything interactive.

One more thing: the DARTS-comparison harness is up; first side-by-side numbers next week.

Wanjiru
